projects.description:
A promotional piece for the JPMorgan Singapore & Asia Equity Income Fund, featuring a pineapple rolling through a house as a visual device to guide viewers through the fund’s core features.

I was responsible for the early storyboard development, the complete 3D execution in Blender, and all post-production, including editing and final color grading.

In the end it was very well received and even got onto places that wasn't planned for at first, like their website for the fund https://am.jpmorgan.com/sg/en/asset-management/per/funds/saei/.

It was also shown in OneRafflePlace's screens and a derivative version in the 10k screen on the Downtown line.
projects.title: JPMorgan SAEI

projects.description:
An immersive, exploratory web experience for prospective students, created for SIT Open House 2026. The goal was to build a functional, navigable “world” that felt lively, approachable, and engaging, while staying within real-time performance constraints on the web.

I led art direction and, together with one other 3D artist, modeled and textured the characters, environment, and props. I also rigged and animated the characters.

Built with Three.js, the project required extensive optimization to run smoothly on mobile. Leveraging low-poly assets, instancing, and strategic mesh merging, alongside ongoing troubleshooting throughout production.

The website has won website of the day and best in all categories from CSS Design Awards. It has also won FWA of the day by The FWA.

Created in collaboration with Hei and Singapore Institute of Technology.
projects.title: SIT Open House 2026

projects.description:
Spearheaded the development of Cinder, a pioneering virtual influencer, leading the team at WAS Singapore.

We brought Cinder to life using Unreal Engine, integrating real-time, full-body and facial motion capture for seamless interactivity.

This groundbreaking technology enabled Cinder to engage audiences dynamically across diverse platforms – from captivating Twitch gaming streams and presenting at conferences, to starring in a complex, interactive live event at SXSW in Austin, Texas, where she personally mixed drinks and played games with attendees.
